change: Bounded disposable cache for FITS preview JPEGs, with process-safe deduplicated reconstruction and no source/asset eviction.

proof: Four independent processes requesting one key invoke the producer once and receive identical complete bytes.
Byte and entry limits evict least-recently-accessed derivatives; oversized responses bypass persistence.
Corrupt/partial cached content regenerates; invalid keys and symlink entries cannot read or delete the original source.
Renderer errors propagate without publishing cache content; cache write failure still serves valid reconstructed bytes.
Real HTTP cache hit does not call the renderer; eviction regenerates identical JPEG bytes with no permanent JPEG available.
Source bytes remain unchanged and cache clearing never traverses scientific asset storage.
Different cold keys serialize across independent processes; a cached key on the same lock stripe responds while a cold render is deliberately blocked.

benchmark.scope: Isolated copies of actual camera FITS with fixed reproducible display settings, not a live production rollout or sustained load test.
benchmark.memory_note: Peak RSS is for the complete benchmark process, including the reference frame preparation and replay, not the isolated memory usage of one production HTTP request.

deployment: Not deployed. Production remains 0cf2de6e/application 994ac136. Capture PID 840928 remains active with NRestarts=0; no archive policy change.
limits: Only authenticated FITS previews currently use the cache; generated-media consumers and broader source-only readers still require integration.
Default service bounds are 512 MiB / 1024 entries; Settings integration is still pending.
The cache evicts disposable JPEG bytes only; lossless processing assets still need separate retention tied to source lifetime.
Portable recipe publication, configurable night/day formats and external storage remain incomplete.
